item.title: Video: How Jesse Tyler Ferguson Is Preparing to Play Truman Capote in TRU
item.description: As previously reported, Jesse Tyler Ferguson is starring as Truman Capote in the first New York revival of Jay Presson Allen’s play Tru. item.title: Kip Williams-Helmed THE MAIDS to be Presented at St. Ann’s Warehouse
item.description: St. Ann’s Warehouse’s 2025-26 season will culminate with The Donmar Warehouse’s production of The Maids, Jean Genet’s masterpiece of class struggle and blurred identity, in a new version written and directed by Kip Williams. item.title: Cynthia Erivo Wins NAACP Image Award for WICKED: FOR GOOD - Full List of Winners
item.description: Cynthia Erivo, Viola Davis, Colman Domingo, Michael B. Jordan, Angela Bassett, and more took home awards this past weekend at the 57th NAACP Image Awards. Hosted by Deon Cole, the evening celebrated the best in Black culture, honoring leaders and cratives cross entertainment, advocacy, and culture. Cynthia Erivo won Outstanding Actress in a Motion Picture for her performance as Elphaba in Wicked: For Good.
